name: Deep Space Indemnity
summary: A string of unexplained space ship wrecks has been discovered in the Xamelea-C sector. As an intergalactic insurance adjuster, you are assigned to investigate each disaster and discover the truth. Rifle through evidence boxes to search through a dizzying number of documents and make deductions about what happened on each ship. Using these insights, answer questions from your megacorp company boss and confirm how and, more importantly, why each ship crashed. Along the way, discover unexpected connections between each ship as you get closer to the unsettling truth that ties all these mysteries together.
